about: LEONIDA_* switches the run scripts set, by graphics card (scripts/leonida-settings.ps1).
Every profile whose match fits the PC's card is applied, in this order; a later one overrides an earlier one.
match: vendor (nvidia, amd, intel), min_vram_mb, max_vram_mb, name (a wildcard on the card's name); empty matches every card.
opt_in: true: never applied by its match, only when LEONIDA_PROFILE names it.

A value of null unsets the switch. LEONIDA_* switches left in the PowerShell window by earlier runs are cleared first (LEONIDA_KEEP_WINDOW=1 keeps them; paths, LEONIDA_PROFILE and LEONIDA_LOG always stay).
Add a profile only with a measurement: the card, the CPU, the scene and the frame times before and after.
Your own changes go in gpu-profiles.local.json (same form, applied after this file; git ignores it).
LEONIDA_PROFILE=<name>[,<name>...] applies base and those profiles whatever the card; LEONIDA_PROFILE=none applies none.
